description: This Java class 'GoodreadsBookImport' models the data structure for importing book information from Goodreads, including fields like title, author, rating, date read, and bookshelves. It also includes a method to map shelf names to predefined shelf enums.

classes.name: GoodreadsBookImport
classes.description: A data class representing a Goodreads book import, with properties for title, author, rating, date read, and bookshelves, along with a static method to convert shelf names.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Converts a shelf name string into an Optional containing a predefined shelf enum value, or empty if the shelf name is blank or unrecognized.
